feats.name: Crafter
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Tool Proficiency.** You gain proficiency with three different Artisan's Tools of your choice.

**Discount.** You get a 20 percent discount when you buy a nonmagical item.

**Fast Crafting.** When you finish a Long Rest, you can make one simple piece of adventuring gear with Artisan's Tools you are proficient with (for example a Ladder with Carpenter's Tools, or a Pouch with Leatherworker's Tools). It falls apart when you finish your next Long Rest.

feats.name: Healer
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Battle Medic.** With a Healer's Kit, you can take the Utilize action and spend one use of the kit to tend a creature within 5 feet. That creature can spend one of its Hit Point Dice; you roll it, and it regains that many Hit Points plus your Proficiency Bonus.

**Healing Rerolls.** When you roll a die to restore Hit Points with a spell or with Battle Medic, you can reroll a 1. You must use the new roll.

feats.name: Lucky
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Luck Points.** You have Luck Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. They come back after a Long Rest.

**Advantage.** When you roll a d20 for a D20 Test, you can spend 1 Luck Point to give yourself Advantage on the roll.

**Disadvantage.** When a creature rolls a d20 for an attack roll against you, you can spend 1 Luck Point to give that roll Disadvantage.

feats.name: Musician
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Instrument Training.** You gain proficiency with three Musical Instruments of your choice.

**Encouraging Song.** As you finish a Short or Long Rest, you can play a song on an instrument you are proficient with. A number of allies who hear it, up to your Proficiency Bonus, gain Heroic Inspiration.

feats.name: Tavern Brawler
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.

**Enhanced Unarmed Strike.** When your Unarmed Strike hits and deals damage, you can deal 1d4 + your Strength modifier Bludgeoning damage instead of the usual damage.

**Damage Rerolls.** When you roll a damage die for your Unarmed Strike, you can reroll a 1. You must use the new roll.

**Improvised Weaponry.** You are proficient with improvised weapons.

**Push.** Once per turn, when your Unarmed Strike hits a creature as part of the Attack action, you can deal the damage and also push it 5 feet away from you.

feats.name: Tough
feats.description: Your Hit Point maximum goes up by twice your character level when you take this feat. Each time you gain a level after that, it goes up by 2 more.
